```plato
// Animates placement along a 3D path given as an ordered run of sampled poses
// (interpolated between samples). StartOffset shifts the starting point; when
// OrientToPath is true, orientation follows the path tangent instead of the
// sampled orientations.
type MotionPath3D
    implements IValue
{
    Poses: Array<Pose3D>;
    OrientToPath: Boolean;
    StartOffset: Proportion;
}

// IProcedural camera shake: seeded noise applied to the camera pose. Amplitude
// is the peak displacement in scene units; Damping is the exponential decay
// rate per second (0 shakes indefinitely).
type CameraShake
    implements IValue
{
    Amplitude: Number;
    Frequency: Frequency;
    Seed: Integer;
    Damping: Number;
}

//==
// # Motion timing and exposure
//
// How a composition's time is measured, remapped, and exposed: frame ranges
// under a fixed rate, remapping of playback time, alignment to a musical beat
// grid, and the shutter settings that turn motion into blur.

// Motion-blur rendering settings. ShutterAngle is the exposure window as an
// angle of the full frame cycle (180 degrees exposes half the frame interval);
// Samples is the number of sub-frame samples accumulated.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Motion_blur_(media))
type MotionBlurSettings
    implements IValue
{
    ShutterAngle: Angle;
    Samples: Integer;
}

// Remaps playback time: sampling the curve at composition time yields the
// source time, in seconds, to show. Non-monotone curves scrub backwards;
// slopes above 1 fast-forward. The curve is any ITimeVarying<Number> — a tween,
// an oscillator, or (once that vocabulary ships) a keyframed AnimationTrack.
type TimeRemap
    implements IValue
{
    Curve: ITimeVarying<Number>;
}

// A playable range of frames under a fixed frame rate: the in point is shown
// first and the out point is exclusive. Both frame times carry Rate.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frame_rate)
type FrameSequence
    implements IValue
{
    Rate: FrameRate;
    InPoint: FrameTime;
    OutPoint: FrameTime;
}

// Aligns animation timing to a musical grid. Triggers fire every Subdivision
// beats (1 is every beat, 0.5 twice per beat), starting Offset beats into the
// piece; combine with Tempo to reach seconds.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Beat_(music))
type BeatSync
    implements IValue
{
    Tempo: Tempo;
    Offset: BeatTime;
    Subdivision: Number;
}
```
